purpose: Falsify the v12 candidates on fresh high-resolution real and synthetic images from one official SID_Set validation shard.

selection.policy: lowest source SHA-256 per label after excluding every locally recorded SID JSONL identity
selection.train_eval_use: evaluation only; never train, tune, calibrate or select a threshold on these rows

evaluation.conditions: clean plus the 19 individually applied workshop conditions
evaluation.secondary: 0.5 clean AUC + 0.5 pooled transformed AUC, worst individual condition AUC

clean_interpretation.at_least_0.80: useful fresh high-resolution same-source evidence, still not broad transfer proof
clean_interpretation.0.65_to_below_0.80: material source or content dependence warning
clean_interpretation.below_0.65: reject the representation as a trusted primary candidate

boundary: SID_Set does not expose the exact generator identity in this extracted shard. A pass cannot establish unseen-generator-family or organizer-hidden-set performance.
